lodgen.config.title: LODgen
lodgen.config.enabled.tooltip: Run automatic generation for DH FEATURES and Voxy. C2ME accelerates the normal chunk pipeline when installed. Command tasks run independently.
lodgen.config.pipelineBatches.tooltip: 1–64 batches per dimension. Higher values keep more chunks in flight and use more memory. Default: 32.
lodgen.config.queuedBatches.tooltip: 0–1024 waiting batches. These requests do not occupy workers. Default: 64.
lodgen.config.spatialBatching.tooltip: Generate nearby terrain together within DH’s distance priority bands to share supporting chunks.
lodgen.config.invalid: Invalid value. Check each setting’s tooltip.
lodgen.config.saveFailed: Could not save lodgen.toml. See the log.
lodgen.config.generationDistance.tooltip: Radius in chunks for chunk-based LOD generation. 0 uses DH’s or Voxy’s distance. Positive values override it. Changes apply immediately; running work finishes.
lodgen.config.showChunksPerSecond.toolti: Show completed LOD chunks per second above the hotbar using Minecraft’s action bar. Hidden at zero throughput or when DH uses its own overlay.
lodgen.config.chunksPerSecondUpdateInter: 1–60000 milliseconds between chunks/second updates. Default: 1000 (one second). The rate still averages the last five seconds. Changes apply immediately.
lodgen.config.generationCenter.tooltip: Choose the moving player position, the world’s spawn, or a fixed horizontal X/Z center. Commands choose their own fixed center.
lodgen.config.centerX.tooltip: Custom horizontal X coordinate in blocks. Used only with Custom X/Z.
lodgen.config.centerZ.tooltip: Custom horizontal Z coordinate in blocks. Used only with Custom X/Z.
lodgen.config.savedChunkRadius.tooltip: Square radius in chunks to save as ordinary terrain. Default 0 keeps LOD-only terrain transient. Normal player and Chunky chunks always retain their saves.
lodgen.config.units: Distances are in chunks; X/Z are in blocks.
